threads.title: In a diet or intervention study the genes are the outcomes and the diet is the exposure, not the other way round
threads.detector: An omics block plus a randomized arm, treatment or dietary exposure column (STUDY_COLUMNS group/treatment/arm; dietary-lens readings), and the user's chosen target. Flags a target that is the arm or a diet variable with the omics block among the predictors, or a target that is one gene among thousands. Outcome-blind facts: arm sizes, and whether the arm was randomized (asked). The researcher settles the estimand.
threads.meaning: The scientific question. 'Which genes does the diet change' means many outcomes and one exposure: one model per gene, with FDR. 'Can expression mark the diet or predict a phenotype' is prediction. 'Does expression mediate diet to outcome' is mediation.

consumers.prediction: The CV score.

threads.title: Samples split by processing batch on the leading components, and batch lines up with case status
threads.detector: Outcome-blind first: PCA of the normalized matrix (training rows under prediction) and each top PC's one-way R² on every settled batch reading (readings.BATCH_KINDS batch/run/plate via recognizers.acquisition_kind). Then a design-balance view: the batch x outcome table over rows with both (methods/batch.py confounding). A design-balance view decides only identifiability (the refusal) and the split scheme, is recorded as an outcome view under both purposes, and never feeds a form, an adjustment set or a predictor; Cramér's V stays out of every form choice. Perfect confounding (every batch holds one outcome level, or a numeric outcome is constant within batch) is critical and refused; V >= 0.1 is asked (imbalance_concern). Under prediction, a shortcut check: in-fold AUC for predicting batch from the features. Alternative to reject: the column is biology (a recruitment site with a different case mix; a run date equal to the visit date). The user settles the batch reading under §14.3, never the values. Measured on genomics_expression (critic, in-process): batch explains R² 0.97 of PC1 and 0.69 of PC2 of log-CPM, and every batch holds 10 cases and 10 controls.
threads.meaning: The column is a technical processing batch, not a study group (set_batch; ledger kind 'batch'); 'not a batch' is a recorded answer. Also which batches hold the cases.

threads.title: Cases were sequenced deeper than controls, so depth alone can predict case status
threads.detector: Library size (column sums) and detected genes per sample, from the assay alone; PC1 of log2(count+1) against log library size. Then a design-balance view: the size ratio and a Mann-Whitney test by outcome (library_size_check; training rows under prediction), recorded as an outcome view under both purposes. Under inference it decides nothing (normalization is offered regardless) and is disclosed in the methods sentence only. Under prediction a depth-only baseline score is computed on the same folds. Assumption, not a rejected alternative: normalization assumes most genes do not change, so without spike-ins a genuine global rise in transcription looks the same as depth (Lovén 2012). Measured on genomics_expression (in-process): case median 38,396 reads vs 32,888 (1.17-fold), depth-only AUC 0.66, Mann-Whitney p = 0.034, PC1 vs log depth r = 0.67; depth also differs by batch (p = 0.02).

threads.title: The values show the processing they have already had (raw counts, estimated counts, CPM/TPM, FPKM, VST, log intensity), and that closes some models
threads.detector: detectors/genomics.card over the pack's nine signatures: per-sample sums, integrality, zero share, maximum, negatives; a back-transform 2^x - offset summing to 1e6 per sample within 5% (log CPM/TPM) or 25% (log TMM-scaled CPM); voom's count+0.5 signature; whole multiples of a per-sample minimum (scaled counts); count quanta (estimated counts); shallow counts; plus omics.scale_finding (counts vs intensities) and the mean-variance slope (1.97 on genomics_expression: overdispersed counts). Values settle the reading where they exclude the alternatives (any negative rules out counts, CPM, TPM, FPKM). CPM vs TPM cannot be decided from the matrix, and once logged no downstream number depends on it (same log2 unit; within a gene they differ by a per-gene constant), so it becomes a blank in the methods sentence filled at reporting, not a blocking question. Asked: estimated counts vs normalized non-integers, shallow counts vs an integer targeted panel, and a log scale whose normalization cannot be recovered. Single-cell signatures hand off to genomics-cells-are-not-replicates.
threads.meaning: Which pipeline produced the values and with what offset; or the values declared already normalized (omics_scale 'declared_normalized'). CPM vs TPM is answered at reporting.

Flag R² >= 0.3, or a technical covariate explaining more of PC1 than any biological covariate. A processing-order or date column also gets a LOESS trend of the per-sample median and PC1 against order (drift, not steps). Then a design-balance view of the covariate by outcome, recorded under both purposes; the adjustment choice rests on the asked meaning, never on the imbalance. A column name only proposes a quality column; the user settles it. Alternative the values cannot reject: the covariate is a consequence of the condition (diseased or autopsy tissue has lower RIN), so this is asked.

threads.title: Samples split on a leading component by something no column names (a lane, an extraction day, a tissue)
threads.detector: Outcome-blind PCA (top 10 PCs; training rows under prediction). For each PC with >= 5% of variance, a real bimodality test on its scores: Hartigan's dip test, or a 2-component Gaussian mixture with a BIC gain and Ashman's D > 2. Silhouette is rejected: k-means silhouette >= 0.5 fired on unimodal normal, uniform and t5 draws at n = 60 in 50 of 50 runs (critic, in-process). Then the PC's adjusted R² against every recorded column and against tokens parsed from sample names (lane L1_/L2_, plate, date prefixes; detectors/lenses.py grammars). Fires only when a name token matches the PC, or the bimodality test passes and no recorded column explains it (max adjusted R² < 0.1). Second detector: block missingness (feature sets absent in the same subset of samples: merged platforms). Only after the factor is named: its table with the outcome, as a design-balance view. Alternatives to reject: one outlier (needs >= 2 samples per mode; otherwise genomics-outlier-sample) and recorded biology (the R² check). Unrecorded biology (sex, tissue, subtype) is asked, never settled by values.
threads.meaning: The researcher names the factor and says whether it is technical (it becomes a batch reading and feeds genomics-batch-aligned-with-case) or biological (a covariate, genomics-mixed-tissue-types, or left alone).

journey_load:
Every thread is now gated, given a tier, and folded into four shared cards:
- **'What drives your leading components'**: one Angles view over a single PC x covariate R² matrix. It covers batch, unrecorded structure, sample quality, depth, draw conditions, mixed tissue and cell mix, and asks at most 2 questions per journey.
- **'Who are your samples'**: one Flow card for orientation, sample-sheet alignment, excluded libraries, sex check, near-identical samples, outliers and pairing.
- **'Where did these come from'**: the provenance card for preselected features, an outcome defined from the features, and sampling after diagnosis.
- **The feature waterfall**: silent and stated rules only. It covers the expression or array detection filter, probe collapse, identifier repairs and p/n.

Expected load by journey:
- **Shipped fixture (genomics_expression, 60 samples, balanced batches, gene_0001 names): 2–3 asks, 0–1 surfaced, about 5 stated.**
  - Asks: confirm the batch reading in one click, the outlier rule (GS031, z = -3.8) and the grain question the fixture requires.
  - Surfaced: depth, only under prediction and only if the model's score lands within 0.05 of the depth-only AUC of 0.66.
  - Stated: batch is balanced; cases are 1.17-fold deeper (AUC 0.66); the filter keeps 252 of 495 genes; 495 genes on 60 samples; the sex check abstains.
  - Unrecorded structure, sample quality and cell mix stay silent.
